label: Contingent thinking cone members of a thought bearer have actual concrete grounds
paraphrase: Analyst formulation: for every occurring-thought bearer b, contingent members x of b's actual concrete ground cone (b itself included) that bear an occurring thought have an actual concrete predecessor. Contingent nonthinking ancestors are not covered; this is weaker in scope than contingent grounding for every member of the full actual cone, but no unconditional truth is asserted.
